blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The complainants in the first and third articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday said the prosecution’s move to abandon most of the charges was a “strategic move” to speed up the trial and secure a faster outcome. In a joint statement, the complainants argued that narrowing the impeachment trial against Duterte does not relieve her of liability or erase the claims, as the dropped charges remain under investigation through other channels. “This is neither an abandonment of accountability nor an erasure of the allegations.
